summary: Educational website that transforms notes into engaging videos and slides, helping users understand subjects clearly from basics to achieve better test scores efficiently

existing_features.title: Create a notes input interface where users can paste or type their study notes in plain text format
Create a slide viewer that displays generated slides with clear typography, organized content sections, and navigation between slides
Create an animated video player that displays generated educational content with smooth transitions between concepts, text animations, and playback controls
Create a library or history view where users can access their previously generated slides and videos for quick revision

Design a clean, study-focused interface with a vibrant yet professional color scheme using energetic gradients (coral/orange to purple/pink), modern sans-serif typography optimized for readability, and a layout that emphasizes content clarity with generous whitespace and clear visual hierarchy

Replace the current vibrant gradient color scheme (coral/orange to purple/pink) with a soft pastel color palette throughout the entire website, including backgrounds, buttons, text highlights, and accent colors

new_feature_requests.summary: Implement backend functionality to process notes and generate structured slide content with key points, definitions, and explanations organized by topic
Implement backend functionality to generate video-style animated content from notes, creating timed sequences that present information progressively
Implement a subject selection or categorization system that allows users to specify the subject area of their notes for contextually appropriate explanations
Update website color scheme to use pastel colors instead of vibrant gradients
